policy.text:
# contracts/policy/privacy.yaml
# Status: draft. Code exists but is NOT wired: src/lifeos/router/gate.py with tests/unit/test_gate.py (APR-0112); nothing calls it yet, so nothing is enforced. Approvals: APR-0001, APR-0007, APR-0045.
schema_version: "1.0"
status: draft
precedence: privacy_wins            # APR-0007: critical complexity never unlocks cloud for high privacy
gate:
  high:
    cloud: denied
    override: "--override-privacy with explicit CEO confirmation; logged; CISO notified"
  medium:
    cloud: low_sensitivity_only
  low:
    cloud: allowed
    budget_gate: true
triage:
  runs_before_gate: true
  model_alias: triage               # APR-0001: local only
channels:
  slack:                            # APR-0045: exemption until the in-house app exists
    data: private_allowed
    condition: private channels only, as the CEO described them
    model_calls: gate_applies       # APR-0007: the exemption does not reach cloud models
    until: in_house_app_built

precedence: privacy_wins
